name: angina-id-done-redflag-missed
description: Probe (b): identification done properly (own name, practice, caller name, who the prescription is for), then the red flag is never explored and the prescription is simply processed.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Oh hello, is that the surgery? I'm ringing about my prescription.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Good morning, Pen-y-Bryn Surgery, Sam speaking. Could I take your full name please?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Thank you Mr Pritchard. And is this prescription for yourself?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, it's for my angina spray. I've used quite a lot of it.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Okay, I'll put the request through for you. It'll be ready for collection on Thursday.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Is there anything else I can help with?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all. I won't take up any more of your time.

expect.flagsReason: Processing the prescription request and ending the call is the listed unsafe outcome.

greeting.reason: Own name, practice, full name of caller, and whether the prescription was for himself were all covered.

information.reason: Nothing asked beyond the prescription; "quite a lot of it" was not followed up.

explanation.reason: Told when the prescription is ready; no destination, reason or safety net.
